Institution_mandate_and_functions: Government coordination body under Road Traffic Safety Law Article 8, with ministerial portfolios and the Road Traffic Safety Agency director. It formally proposed the 2023–2030 national strategy; the 2021 coordination body commissioned a draft and tasked the Agency with preparation. The Government adopted the strategy and 2023–2025 action plan on 28 September 2023 (Official Gazette 84/2023, 5 October). The government's later 2025 reconstitution/inaugural meeting is a separate organizational milestone. The coordination body subsequently designated the Agency and Interior Ministry to lead preparation of a successor action plan for 2026–2028; no final Government adoption was verified as of 18 November 2026.

Participating_entities_English_translati: Ministers responsible for Interior, Transport, Health, Labour, Justice, Education and Trade; Director of the Road Traffic Safety Agency. These are statutory government seats, not all members of the 32-organization strategy drafting working group.
Responsible_government_hierarchy: Government of Serbia (formal strategy/action-plan adopter) → Road Traffic Safety Coordination Body (statutory coordination and proposal) → Road Traffic Safety Agency and expert groups (technical drafting and implementation monitoring); operational ministries and national/regional/local institutions deliver assigned measures under their own mandates.
Membership_verification_status: Seven statutory ministerial portfolios and one Agency director established in national law; individuals and membership of expert working groups must be distinguished from the ministerial body.
Research_notes: 2023 national strategy and 2023–2025 plan are Government-approved, not uniquely authored by the coordination body. The strategy drafting working group included 32 organizations; those contributors are not automatically statutory council seats. The successor 2026–2028 plan is in preparation, approval not verified. Do not treat the new 2025 body meeting as the establishment date of the policy-development process started in 2021.
